summary.text: Abden S. Simmons, a Republican, represents House District 45 (Bremen, Friendship, Louds Island Township, Waldoboro and Washington) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Waldoboro. The House profile lists membership on the Marine Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 128th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives commercial fisherman as the occupation.
It says Simmons is married, to April, with one child.
